purpose: Correct a numerical implementation artifact in the already-failed semantic-adjusted OECD reconciliation by recomputing the retained observations with exact base-10 Decimal arithmetic. Preserve the historical workflow execution and frozen 0.1 million RON tolerance; do not rerun or reacquire source values.

exact_decimal_reaudit.source: Retained exact_filtered_source_rows_with_semantic_zero.csv from the historical workflow artifact; no provider request performed.
exact_decimal_reaudit.arithmetic: Parse each retained value lexeme as an exact base-10 Decimal, sum F2-F8 by sector/entry, apply the frozen sector mapping and semantic S1M/L/F2=0 rule, and compare |residual| > Decimal('0.1').

numerical_bug_classification.root_cause: Some exact decimal residuals equal to ±0.1 million RON were represented as binary floats infinitesimally above the frozen threshold and therefore classified as violations by abs(residual) > 0.1.

ecb_guideline.point: NCBs are instructed to implement accounting-identity/sign validation rules before transmitting quarterly financial-account data to the ECB.

ecb_quality_report_2024.source: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts – Quality report 2024
ecb_quality_report_2024.interpretation: The ECB reports minor historical validation exceptions for Romania. This contextualises why public disseminated data cannot simply be assumed mathematically exact, but it does not identify the specific 2025-2026 residuals or authorize any tolerance change.
